facts.text: The Garden State Guarantee provides up to four semesters of free tuition and mandatory fees for eligible third- and fourth-year New Jersey residents at NJIT.

sources.title: Garden State Guarantee Program | Financial Aid - NJIT
sources.quote: The Garden State Guarantee (GSG) program will provide up to four semesters of free tuition and mandatory fees for undergraduate, New Jersey resident students who attend in-state, public four-year institutions.
